text: Councillor Kristyn Wong-Tam, Chair, Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee has submitted a final Chair's report extending appreciation and providing a summary of the Committee's accomplishments.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Vice Chairs, Toronto Accessibility Committee to send a letter to Kristyn Wong-Tam to convey best wishes and the Committee's appreciation for her leadership, service and accomplishments toward improving accessibility in the City of Toronto.
